data.name: Lavita
data.gender_notes: Lavita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lavana’, meaning ‘lovely’, ‘radiant’ or ‘bright’. This name is associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity, wealth, and beauty. The name Lavita carries the meaning “Lovely, Radiant, Bright” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lavita usually hope their child will grow to embody lovely, radiant, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Lavita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lovely, Radiant, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lavita total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Lavita is a popular one in the Hindu culture, often given to baby girls at birth. The name carries a positive connotation, suggesting beauty, radiance, and charm. In Hindu society, the name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, making it an embodiment of good fortune, wealth, and spiritual abundance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Lavita holds rich spiritual significance in Hinduism. Shouldered with the blessing of the Goddess Lakshmi, the name symbolizes purity, grace, and prosperity. It encourages the person to embrace their inner radiance and beauty, and work towards achieving inner wealth and happiness, rather than material riches alone. The name is a constant reminder of the divine presence of Goddess Lakshmi, guiding and nurturing one throughout their life journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Lavita, meaning 'clothed in purity', represents the inner radiance and spotless nature of an enlightened soul. It symbolizes the purification of the mind and body, leading to a life filled with divinity and grace.
